issues.what: Tang Hexi, Longyou and Dunhuang drawn as nobody's land (about 10,000 cell-years) because the Tang keyframes 757, 763 and 768 stopped at Cliopatria's shape. The overrides keep Hexi Tang until the Tibetan conquest (Liangzhou, Jiuquan and Lanzhou go Tibetan in 764) and keep Dunhuang and Guazhou Tang to 785 (Tibetan from 786).

Umayyad Morocco and Algeria drawn too early (705-707 snap added 1913 cells; the 701 snap went from 241 to 2,929 added cells after p0600-p0699's Algeria patch). Subtracted Morocco and non-Numidian Algeria from Cliopatria 705 and the 692 shape for 701-704.
Byzantine inner Anatolia 718-723 drawn Umayyad after the 718 snap; restored Byzantine land inside the 36-42.5 N, 26-36 E box from Cliopatria 717.

Melayu Kingdom held Jambi from 692 to 1027 because the merge with Srivijaya was applied in the wrong direction (about 18,100 cell-years in the window). Added a 692 gain for Srivijaya from Melayu; page: annexed by Srivijaya 692, independence restored 1028.

Kingdom of Neustria dissolved in 724 and its remaining 1,526 cells went to nobody (successors intersect its own cells), erasing the Frankish core for 724-731 (about 12,000 cell-years). Override gives Neustria its own Cliopatria 724 shape so the dissolve hands the right land on.
Dzungaria and Beshbalik nobody's in 793-799. Pages say the Tibetans briefly held Beshbalik in 790 and are silent after that; Tang presence at Beiting is attested only for 789.
Yaxchilan and Bonampak: Bonampak's page gives no coordinates for a polity border, so no subordinate shape could be drawn.
Kannauj shape in 725 is generous and the Qinghai contested overlay (Tang and Tibet) runs long; both follow the dossiers.

Size-rule conflicts checked: Tang/Tibetan, Pratihara/Umayyad, Nanzhao/Tang, Austrasia/Franks (Austrasia 741-751 per its dossier, R2) and Alamannia/Franks (Charles Martel's 730-732 campaigns). The winner in each case agrees with the dossiers. The Austrasia/Franks and Alamannia/Franks pairs shift in the trial (1761 to 1758 cell-years, and 4 to 181); I did not trace the cause.

Principality of Armenia and Principality of Iberia vassal rows end in 743 but the Umayyad state lasts to 750, leaving 744-750 untinted; the Abbasid rows start in 751. These are hierarchy.csv rows, which a patch cannot fix; reported under problems for the orchestrator.

Principality of Abasgia (Black Sea coast between the Gumista and Bzyb rivers, 7,076 km2 in Cliopatria's Georgia row 724-777) has no dossier, so the coast is nobody's land in 724-777. Page infobox: Established 64, Disestablished 786. The Kingdom of Abkhazia dossier already notes that it needs a dossier. Also Lazica's cells pass to Abkhazia one year early (777, 66 cells) through the dossier's own 777 dissolve; left, one year only.

Kashmir (625-1339) and Karkota Dynasty (625-855) look like one state in two dossiers: same start year, same Alchon Huns predecessor, 316 and 328 cells in the packet. No conflict is listed between them, so they are drawn on separate land. I did not open either page; flag only.
